criticisms: The phrase 'two distinct episodes of elevated global seismic activity' for the two 9-event days is a mild overreach — daily count variation of this magnitude is within normal background noise and the report does not establish a baseline to justify calling these 'distinct episodes' of elevated global activity.

The 'roughly 0.6 events per day' rate calculation is presented without acknowledging that this rate is derived from a small, filtered sample and may not be statistically meaningful for forecasting purposes.
The report is otherwise well-calibrated; all five checklist items pass cleanly.
